takes.h: Godzilla Minus Zero/Minus Color listed for December 11, 2026
takes.p: Dread Central reports a black-and-white version of Takashi Yamazaki’s Godzilla Minus Zero, titled Godzilla Minus Zero/Minus Color, is listed for a December 11, 2026, release, the same treatment previously given to Godzilla Minus One. The sequel picks up in 1949, two years after Minus One.
